component: experimental ScummVM Gob Lost in Time headless sidecar
upstream_license: GPL-3.0-or-later; see ScummVM COPYING and file notices; selected Gob files additionally dual-licensed LGPL-2.1
tested_platform: macOS arm64, clang 21.0.0, null backend, Gob engine only

qualification.wrong_language_fallback: en is generic English; safely reported as unrecognized and wrapper refuses it
qualification.gameplay_scene_comparison: separate coordinator evidence; not implied by these debugger checks

previous_build8_adapter_tests.limit: Did not cover repeated populated retained event reads; superseded by live invalid-free discovery and build9 repair

source_identity.script_scope: loaded code prefix, including 128-byte TOT header, through native scriptEnd
source_identity.source_scope: actual successful DataIO archive/loose stream lookup, raw member FNV and decompressed loaded-script FNV
source_identity.lookup_precedence: last opened archive first, then loose file; embedded video fallback remains unknown
source_identity.generation: process-local monotonically increasing successful Script loads and native writeByte modifications

safe_points: backend event polls and delays during waits/media/input
execution.instruction_unit: completed dispatches including nested func/draw/gob; pending caller depth retained
execution.trace_span_scope: raw opcode encoding only; operand extent and branch semantics remain uninterpreted
execution.breakpoint_resume: skip current boundary only when resuming from a breakpoint stop; after-opcode resume never skips the next loop hit
execution.breakpoint_removal: Stored breakpoint identity may be removed after script unload or generation transition; breakpoint creation remains strict against currently loaded identity and source bytes

watch_coverage: scalar/string/copy variable accessors with byte-range alias overlap; excludes direct pointer dereferences, direct stream reads, and arbitrary arena replacement
original_inputs: private Lost in Time resources, read-only; no original files edited
preserved_components: prior ScummVM 2.8.1 AGI source and executable
stock application managed separately by coordinator
distribution_scope: source patch and build recipe only; no commit, push, release or system sidecar installation
known_limits: A host deadline is serviced at interpreter and backend safe points; arbitrary blocking external library calls are outside the hook coverage
Raw trace span covers opcode encoding only; complete operand extent is not decoded
Watch coverage is limited to instrumented scalar/string/copy accessors, not all pointer-based I/O
No native Gob checkpoint or script patch operation is advertised
retained_json_ownership: Capped trace and hotspot event rings retain shared-owned JSONValue trees; each response deep-copies JSONValue contents; ring eviction and clear release owned trees
